 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs/task-257e343e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r1, c1 = ones[0]
    r2, c2 = twos[0]
    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
    sr = (dr > 0) - (dr < 0)
    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)
    n = min(abs(dr), abs(dc))
    # Trace the diagonal toward the target, stopping one diagonal step short.
    for k in range(1, n):
        out[r1 + sr * k][c1 + sc * k] = 3
    # Continue along the longer axis until diagonally adjacent to the target.
    if abs(dr) > abs(dc):
        r_start = r1 + sr * n
        c_fixed = c1 + sc * n
        for r in range(r_start, r2, sr):
            if (r, c_fixed) != (r2, c2):
                out[r][c_fixed] = 3
    elif abs(dc) > abs(dr):
        r_fixed = r1 + sr * n
        c_start = c1 + sc * n
        for c in range(c_start, c2, sc):
            out[r_fixed][c] = 3
    return out
"
